name: Team Performance
description: Multi-project Jira + git + Bitbucket delivery analytics: per-ticket phases (design only where evidenced, dev, PR pickup/review, QA wait vs rework, deploy, rework charge-back), DORA from deployed/hf/hotfix tags, flow metrics (WIP, throughput, investment, unplanned, estimate accuracy, context switching), capacity from per-person time off, per-metric guardrails, robust AI scope estimates, paced PR ingestion through Otto, and deterministic commentable HTML reports. Node sidecar — zero npm install.
